sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 Dealbook 的

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场，采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的现场对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 我们将于 11 月 18 日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，

sentences.en: 18th.
sentences.zh: 供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天是。

sentences.en: An update on the state of the coronavirus in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 关于美国冠状病毒疫情最新进展的报道。

sentences.en: I check back in with Times science reporter, Donald G.
sentences.zh: 我再次连线了《纽约时报》科学记者唐纳德·G·

sentences.en: McNeil Jr.
sentences.zh: 麦克尼尔。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 10 月 7 日，星期三。

sentences.en: Donald, you recently sent me an email that pretty much stopped me in my tracks because in it, you said that you were optimistic about the course of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德，你最近给我发了一封电子邮件，让我几乎惊呆了，因为你在信中说你对这场大流行的走势感到乐观。

sentences.en: And that is not a word that I associate with either you or the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 而这个词我既不会联想到你，也不会联想到这场大流行。

sentences.en: And it immediately made me think that we needed to talk.
sentences.zh: 这立刻让我觉得我们需要聊聊。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I can explain.
sentences.zh: 我可以解释。

sentences.en: I am short-term right now, fall and winter, pessimistic.
sentences.zh: 就短期而言，也就是今年秋冬，我很悲观。

sentences.en: I think things are going to get worse.
sentences.zh: 我认为情况会变得更糟。

sentences.en: But since I've been saying since April or so that this epidemic is not going to be over by Easter, this epidemic is not going to be over by fall, and that the record for making
sentences.zh: 但自从大约四月份以来我一直在说，这场疫情不会在复活节前结束，这场疫情不会在秋季前结束，而且制造

sentences.en: a vaccine is four years, I now have new optimism about how fast I expect vaccines and other
sentences.zh: 疫苗的纪录是四年，我现在有了新的乐观态度，关于我预计疫苗和其他

sentences.en: interventions to get here and how quickly that will bring the pandemic to an end in the United States.
sentences.zh: 干预措施到来的速度会有多快，以及这将以多快的速度在美国终结这场大流行。

sentences.en: So it sounds like you have a qualified, long-term optimism.
sentences.zh: 听起来你持有一种有条件的、长期的乐观态度。

sentences.en: And I want to get to that.
sentences.zh: 我想深入探讨这一点。

sentences.en: But for now, let's explore your shorter-term pessimism by understanding where we are right now in the pandemic, starting with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但现在，让我们先通过了解目前大流行在美国所处的位置，来探讨你较为短期的悲观情绪，从美国开始。

sentences.en: What's happened in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国发生的事情

sentences.en: is really, in some ways, one giant wave with geographical distinction.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面实际上是一场具有地域差异的巨大浪潮。

sentences.en: In the spring, the Northeast was hit very hard.
sentences.zh: 在春季，东北部受到的打击非常严重。

sentences.en: New York City, Boston, some of the other cities.
sentences.zh: 纽约市、波士顿以及其他一些城市。

sentences.en: But it was a very concentrated, very intense epidemic.
sentences.zh: 但这是一场非常集中、非常猛烈的疫情。

sentences.en: Then there was the big summer wave, which began mostly in the South.
sentences.zh: 然后是夏季的大浪潮，主要始于南部。

sentences.en: It was the Southern states.
sentences.zh: 那是南方的几个州。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, you've always had a sort of smoldering thing going on in California, particularly, but also in Oregon and Washington.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，加利福尼亚州，特别是俄勒冈州和华盛顿州，一直有一种类似闷烧的疫情在持续。

sentences.en: The third part of this big, if you like, first wave is now hitting the Midwest, and especially the upper Midwest, Wisconsin, Minnesota, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Utah.
sentences.zh: 这场巨大的（如果你愿意这么称呼的话）第一波疫情的第三部分现在正袭击中西部，尤其是中西部北部，威斯康星州、明尼苏达州、北达科他州、南达科他州和犹他州。

sentences.en: And so now they're suffering through it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在正在经历痛苦。

sentences.en: So if we think of the first wave as this giant body of water sloshing around the country, it's finally reaching all the different crevices and coastlines.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们把第一波疫情想象成在全国范围内泼溅的巨大水体，它终于到达了所有不同的缝隙和海岸线。

sentences.en: And the latest one is the Midwest, the mountain states, the plains.
sentences.zh: 最新受影响的是中西部、山地州和平原地区。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And now things are beginning to tick up again, even in New York City and some places that had really done quite well all through the summer.
sentences.zh: 现在情况又开始抬头了，甚至在纽约市和整个夏天都做得相当不错的某些地方也是如此。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: In Brooklyn and Queens, we're having an extraordinary problem, something we haven't seen since the spring.
sentences.zh: 在布鲁克林和皇后区，我们遇到了非同寻常的问题，这是我们在春季以来从未见过的。

sentences.en: Well, tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，跟我讲讲这个。

sentences.en: What is happening in New York City?
sentences.zh: 纽约市正在发生什么？

sentences.en: Because that doesn't so much feel like a first wave encounter.
sentences.zh: 因为这感觉不那么像第一波疫情的遭遇。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 确实不是。

sentences.en: And what's going on in New York City is very, very much neighborhood by neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 纽约市现在的情况很大程度上是挨个社区出现的。

sentences.en: What has become clear is that there are a number of neighborhoods now that have continued to have
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，现在有许多社区

sentences.en: a high level of coronavirus positivity, and that requires stronger action than we've had to take for many months.
sentences.zh: 持续保持着高水平的冠状病毒阳性率，这需要采取比我们过去几个月来不得不采取的更强有力的行动。

sentences.en: You know, the mayor and the governor are struggling over whether or not to shut down nine zip codes in the city.
sentences.zh: 你知道，市长和州长正在争论是否要关闭该市的九个邮政编码区域。

sentences.en: We are all in this together.
sentences.zh: 我们休戚与共。

sentences.en: We have overcome much worse than this challenge, and we will overcome this one as well.
sentences.zh: 我们已经克服了比这糟糕得多的挑战，我们也将克服这一次的挑战。

sentences.en: Thank you, everyone.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: And what in your mind explains this second wave in New York City?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，是什么解释了纽约市的这第二波疫情？

sentences.en: And I think the reason why so many people care about New York City, and I'm asking about it, is because it seemed like the city had a very good handle on the virus.
sentences.zh: 我想为什么有这么多人关心纽约市，而我也在问这个问题，是因为这座城市似乎对病毒有很好的控制。

sentences.en: The city did have a good handle on the virus, and a lot of people were cooperating, wearing masks and socially distancing.
sentences.zh: 这座城市确实对病毒有很好的控制，而且很多人都在配合，佩戴口罩并保持社交距离。

sentences.en: But we've begun to ease off on the restrictions.
sentences.zh: 但我们已经开始放松限制了。

sentences.en: You know, schools are reopening.
sentences.zh: 你知道，学校正在重新开放。

sentences.en: There was a plan to let restaurants open indoors as long as they only had 25 percent of their crowds.
sentences.zh: 曾有一个计划，允许餐馆在客流量仅为百分之二十五的情况下开放室内用餐。

sentences.en: And also, we've seen a really strong uptick in the Orthodox Jewish and Hasidic neighborhoods in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们看到布鲁克林的东正教犹太人和哈西德派社区出现了非常强劲的反弹。

sentences.en: Those were neighborhoods that were hit really hard in the spring, particularly around Purim, which happened before really there was any notion that the virus
sentences.zh: 这些社区在春季受到的打击非常严重，尤其是普珥节前后，那发生在真正意识到病毒

sentences.en: was as widespread as the city was.
sentences.zh: 像这座城市那样广泛传播之前。

sentences.en: Large numbers of people died.
sentences.zh: 大量的人死亡了。

sentences.en: There were funerals of important rabbis.
sentences.zh: 有重要拉比的葬礼。

sentences.en: At those funerals, nobody wore masks.
sentences.zh: 在那些葬礼上，没有人戴口罩。

sentences.en: People were all together.
sentences.zh: 人们都聚在一起。

sentences.en: Weddings, birthday parties, everything else.
sentences.zh: 婚礼、生日派对，以及其他一切。

sentences.en: And then there was a big wave of deaths.
sentences.zh: 然后是一大波死亡潮。

sentences.en: One Barrel Society reported burying seven times as many people as it normally did.
sentences.zh: 一个殡仪社团报告说，他们埋葬的人数是平常的七倍。

sentences.en: They ran out of burial shrouds.
sentences.zh: 他们的葬礼裹尸布都用完了。

sentences.en: And then cases by June seemed to virtually disappear in the Hasidic communities.
sentences.zh: 然后到六月份，哈西德派社区的病例似乎几乎消失了。

sentences.en: And the belief kind of grew that, you know, we have achieved herd immunity in those neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 人们渐渐产生了一种信念，你知道，我们在这些社区实现了群体免疫。

sentences.en: So I don't know why, but by September, cases were ticking up again in the Hasidic communities.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道为什么，但到了九月，哈西德派社区的病例又开始上升了。

sentences.en: And we've seen that although nine zip codes in the city are the ones that are being hit hardest and those all contain Big Hasidic communities, it's now actually spreading
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到，尽管该市的九个邮政编码区域是受打击最严重的，而且这些区域都包含大型哈西德派社区，但它实际上现在正在蔓延

sentences.en: to about 20 other zip codes in the city.
sentences.zh: 到该市大约其他 20 个邮政编码区域。

sentences.en: And what is the city doing in response to what's happening in these nine zip codes?
sentences.zh: 为了应对这九个邮政编码区域发生的情况，该市正在采取什么行动？

sentences.en: Well, they're planning to shut down schools and they're talking about trying to shut down businesses in those areas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们正计划关闭学校，并且在讨论试图关闭这些地区的商业。

sentences.en: And there's now sort of a public tug of war going on between the governor and the mayor over that.
sentences.zh: 目前州长和市长之间就此展开了一场公开的拉锯战。

sentences.en: So it's not clear.
sentences.zh: 所以目前还不清楚。

sentences.en: This is all in keeping with the notion of the hammer and the dance, you know, dance in, dance out.
sentences.zh: 这一切都符合铁锤与舞蹈的概念，你知道，跳进去，跳出来。

sentences.en: And you dance out into more open behavior, you know, more face-to-face relations with each other until you get a problem.
sentences.zh: 你跳进更加开放的行为中，你知道，彼此之间更多的面对面交往，直到你遇到问题。

sentences.en: And then you have to dance back in, you know, step away from each other, close down bars and restaurants, have smaller grouping of people.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须跳回来，你知道，彼此保持距离，关闭酒吧和餐厅，减少人员聚集。

sentences.en: And all through this time, we should be wearing masks.
sentences.zh: 而在这一切期间，我们都应该佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of resistance to wearing masks, particularly in the Hasidic communities.
sentences.zh: 人们对戴口罩有很多抵触情绪，特别是在哈西德派社区。

sentences.en: I'm curious what you think about a decision like the one to allow for indoor dining.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你对允许室内用餐这样的决定有什么看法。

sentences.en: And to a certain degree, indoor shopping, knowing that the city has spikes in certain neighborhoods and that people
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上还有室内购物，鉴于该市某些社区出现了疫情高峰，而且来自

sentences.en: from those neighborhoods could inevitably end up at one of these restaurants eating indoors.
sentences.zh: 这些社区的人不可避免地最终会去其中一间餐厅进行室内用餐。

sentences.en: Does that seem wise?
sentences.zh: 这看起来明智吗？

sentences.en: Is that just a necessary risk required to keep that industry alive?
sentences.zh: 这只是保持该行业存活所需的必要风险吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's a risk that the city is taking because the restaurant industry is important to the city's economy and has a fair amount of clout in the city.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是这座城市正在承担的风险，因为餐饮业对城市的经济很重要，并且在城市里有相当大的影响力。

sentences.en: I personally don't want to eat indoors in a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我个人不想在餐馆的室内用餐。

sentences.en: I'm okay with eating outdoors.
sentences.zh: 我赞成在户外用餐。

sentences.en: I know it's going to get a little chilly, but I'd rather do that than eat indoors.
sentences.zh: 我知道天气会变冷一点，但我宁愿那样做也不愿在室内吃。

sentences.en: And I think I know why, but why aren't you comfortable eating indoors at a restaurant at this moment?
sentences.zh: 我想我知道原因，但为什么此刻你对在餐馆室内用餐感到不舒服？

sentences.en: Because the virus clearly lingers in the air indoors as it doesn't outdoors.
sentences.zh: 因为病毒显然像在户外不会那样，在室内的空气中存留。

sentences.en: And you have to take off your mask to eat and drink.
sentences.zh: 而且你必须摘下口罩才能吃东西和喝水。

sentences.en: So what can you do?
sentences.zh: 所以你能怎么办？

sentences.en: You can't really protect yourself against it.
sentences.zh: 你真的无法防范它。

sentences.en: I mean, other people may feel differently, but the privilege of eating out in a restaurant is something I can wait on for a few months.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，其他人可能会有不同的感觉，但在餐馆里外出就餐的特权是我可以等上几个月的事情。

sentences.en: I'm cooking fine at home.
sentences.zh: 我在家里做饭挺好的。

sentences.en: I'm happy eating outdoors if I have to not eat indoors.
sentences.zh: 如果我不得不不在室内吃，我很高兴在户外吃。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, more painful for me is things like I don't want to have a Thanksgiving or a Christmas, you know, big family one indoors.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，对我来说更痛苦的事情是诸如我不想过感恩节或圣诞节，你知道，室内的大型家庭聚会。

sentences.en: And we're discussing this now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正在讨论这个。

sentences.en: I just, I just think it's dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我只是觉得这很危险。

sentences.en: Even though I trust all my relatives,
sentences.zh: 尽管我信任我所有的亲戚，

sentences.en: I've seen, you know, some close calls with relatives and friends of mine.
sentences.zh: 我看到过，你知道，我的亲戚和朋友经历过一些险情。

sentences.en: Oh, well, for example, my niece in Salt Lake City had a close call and found out that she had been at a party where somebody
sentences.zh: 哦，例如，我在盐湖城的侄女经历了一次险情，发现她曾去过一个有人

sentences.en: was infected and found out just after her mother had visited her.
sentences.zh: 感染的派对，并且在她母亲去看望她之后不久才发现这一点。

sentences.en: And so everybody was behaving fairly carefully, but not perfectly carefully.
sentences.zh: 所以每个人都表现得相当谨慎，但并非完美地谨慎。

sentences.en: And then suddenly, bingo, they found out, you know, that one of them was a contact and other contacts had taken place before that contact tested positive.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间，太棒了，他们发现，你知道，其中一个人是密接者，而其他接触在那名密接者检测呈阳性之前就已经发生了。

sentences.en: So, I mean, that's a perfect example of a chain of transmission.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，那是传播链的一个完美例子。

sentences.en: And the goal is to break the chain of transmission.
sentences.zh: 而目标是打破传播链。

sentences.en: Right, right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: And I'm sure your niece is going to be thrilled to hear that she is now a public case study.
sentences.zh: 我确信你侄女听到自己现在成了一个公开的案例研究会兴奋不已。

sentences.en: But thanks to your niece, we now understand the situation better.
sentences.zh: 但多亏了你的侄女，我们现在更好地理解了这种情况。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'll talk to her about it.
sentences.zh: 我会跟她谈谈这事的。

sentences.en: We'll see if she ever talked to me again.
sentences.zh: 我们看看她以后还会不会跟我说话。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: So, Donald, none of this feels like the basis for optimism, that word you used at the beginning of this conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以，唐纳德，这些都不能成为乐观的基础，也就是你在这次对话开始时使用的那个词。

sentences.en: And I think many of us are sadly, like you, thinking about the holidays, thinking about how they're not going to feel normal at all.
sentences.zh: 我想我们中的许多人不幸地也和你一样，在考虑假期，考虑它们将如何一点也不像正常情况。

sentences.en: And if you look at the dashboard the Times has for where the virus is in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果你看一下《纽约时报》关于美国目前疫情所在位置的仪表盘，

sentences.en: right now, it shows that we have infections on the order of 40,000 a day.
sentences.zh: 它显示我们的感染人数达到了每天 4 万左右的水平。

sentences.en: And that has been the case now for many weeks, I think even months.
sentences.zh: 这种情况已经持续了好几个星期，我想甚至是好几个月。

sentences.en: And given that, and given what we're seeing in New York and in the Mountain States and in the
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，并鉴于我们在纽约、山地州和中西部看到的情况，

sentences.en: Midwest, do you expect that things are actually just going to get worse as the weather gets colder
sentences.zh: 随着天气变冷、人们待在室内，你是否预计情况实际上只会变得更糟，

sentences.en: and people stay inside and that we are not in for any kind of relief anytime soon?
sentences.zh: 并且我们在短期内不会得到任何形式的缓解？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think things are already getting worse.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为情况已经在恶化了。

sentences.en: I mean, we're definitely on an upward trend, and it is in a majority of states that we're on an upward trend in.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们绝对处于上升趋势中，而且我们在大多数州都处于上升趋势。

sentences.en: So that's not a good sign.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是一个好兆头。

sentences.en: That makes me pessimistic for the immediate future.
sentences.zh: 这让我对近期前景感到悲观。

sentences.en: But I'm optimistic in my view of when this all ends and we go back to normal.
sentences.zh: 但我对这一切何时结束以及我们何时恢复正常的看法保持乐观。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So Donald, walk us through this optimism you have for the end of the pandemic and what accounts for it and what does that optimism look like?
sentences.zh: 那么唐纳德，请跟我们讲讲你对大流行结束的这种乐观态度，是什么促成了它，这种乐观态度是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, when we talked about vaccines a while ago, I made the point that the fastest the world had ever made a vaccine was four years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不久前当我们谈论疫苗时，我指出人类制造出疫苗的最快纪录是四年。

sentences.en: That was a mumps vaccine back in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 那是 20 世纪 60 年代的腮腺炎疫苗。

sentences.en: And thought, okay, that's not encouraging.
sentences.zh: 当时想，好吧，这并不令人鼓舞。

sentences.en: Maybe we can cut that in half.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以把时间缩短一半。

sentences.en: Maybe we can make something in two years.
sentences.zh: 也许我们能在两年内造出某种东西。

sentences.en: Right now, it's looking like we are going to have some approved vaccines by late December, early
sentences.zh: 现在看来，我们将在 12 月底、1 月初

sentences.en: January.
sentences.zh: 获得一些获批的疫苗。

sentences.en: And if only three out of the eight we have in the works work, we will eventually have enough doses for all Americans.
sentences.zh: 如果我们在研发中的八种疫苗里只有三种起作用，我们最终将拥有足够所有美国人使用的剂量。

sentences.en: It will take longer.
sentences.zh: 这需要更长的时间。

sentences.en: But as far as I can tell, those clinical trials, if you look at the phase one and phase two data and you look at the data in monkeys and things like
sentences.zh: 但据我所能判断的，那些临床试验，如果你看看一期和二期数据，如果你看看在猴子身上以及诸如此类的数据

sentences.en: that, they're going pretty well.
sentences.zh: 总体来看，情况进展得相当顺利。

sentences.en: So the biggest basis for your optimism is the fact that you believe we are just months away from an approved vaccine that will in somewhat short order be available to Americans.
sentences.zh: 所以你乐观的最大依据在于，你相信我们离推出获批的疫苗只有几个月的时间了，而且这些疫苗很快就能提供给美国人。

sentences.en: I believe we are probably close to several approved vaccines.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们可能很快就会有几款获批的疫苗。

sentences.en: And then the challenge is how fast can you make them?
sentences.zh: 接下来的挑战是，能以多快的速度生产它们？

sentences.en: And in the beginning, it's going to be 10 to 20 million doses per month.
sentences.zh: 一开始，产量将达到每月1000万到2000万剂。

sentences.en: But then that will ramp up.
sentences.zh: 但随后产量会迅速提升。

sentences.en: And we're ultimately going to need 660 million doses or so.
sentences.zh: 我们最终大概需要6.6亿剂疫苗。

sentences.en: If all the vaccines worked, we would have 800 million doses.
sentences.zh: 如果所有疫苗都有效，我们将拥有8亿剂疫苗。

sentences.en: And then the question is, will people take them?
sentences.zh: 那么问题来了，人们会接种吗？

sentences.en: And although there is skepticism now, I believe people will.
sentences.zh: 尽管现在存在怀疑态度，但我相信人们会的。

sentences.en: And that's something else I can explain.
sentences.zh: 这也是我可以解释的事情。

sentences.en: Well, why don't you explain it?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你为什么不解释一下呢？

sentences.en: Because I think that's a question we have explored a lot on the show.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为这是我们在节目中探讨过很多次的问题。

sentences.en: And in our conversations with colleagues like Jen Hoffman, we have established that there is a considerable amount of skepticism around vaccines in general, and especially this
sentences.zh: 通过与珍·霍夫曼等同事的对话，我们发现，公众对疫苗普遍存在相当大的怀疑，尤其是对即将推出的

sentences.en: coming set of vaccines because of how much politics has surrounded them.
sentences.zh: 这批疫苗，因为它们被赋予了太多的政治色彩。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I agree with that skepticism.
sentences.zh: 我同意这种怀疑态度。

sentences.en: I mean, if a vaccine is approved before election day and it is approved by only one man, I'm Donald J.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果一款疫苗在选举日前获批，并且是由一个人批准的：我是唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump and I approve this vaccine, then I'm a skeptic and I'm not going to take it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普，我批准了这款疫苗，那我也是个怀疑论者，我不会去接种它。

sentences.en: But when I see vaccines that are okayed by Tony Fauci and Paul Offit and Francis
sentences.zh: 但当我看到疫苗获得托尼·福奇、保罗·奥菲特、弗朗西斯

sentences.en: Collins and Peter Hotez and all the vaccine experts that you often see quoted on television, then I'm going to be one of the first in line to get it.
sentences.zh: 柯林斯、彼得·霍特兹以及你在电视上经常看到的那些疫苗专家的批准时，我就会排在最前面去接种。

sentences.en: And what will probably happen, I think, is that a lot of people will be skeptical and then they'll look around at their friends and neighbors
sentences.zh: 我想，接下来可能会发生的是，很多人会持怀疑态度，然后他们会看看身边的朋友和邻居

sentences.en: who take the vaccine and assuming nothing goes wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果他们去接种了疫苗，且假设一切顺利的话。

sentences.en: And that's that's an assumption.
sentences.zh: 当然，这只是一个假设。

sentences.en: But assuming nothing goes wrong, they'll go, huh, I can avoid this vaccine for me and my kids that I'm somewhat afraid of.
sentences.zh: 但假设一切顺利，他们会想：呃，我和我的孩子可以不用接种这让我有点害怕的疫苗了。

sentences.en: And that means I have to homeschool my kids forever, never go to a movie, never get on an airplane, never eat in a restaurant again, or I can accept the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我必须永远在家教孩子、再也不能看电影、再也不能坐飞机、再也不能在餐馆吃饭，或者我可以接受这款疫苗。

sentences.en: I think I'll take the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 我想我会接种疫苗。

sentences.en: So you're saying that we may be overestimating the amount of skepticism in the American public for
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，我们可能高估了美国公众对

sentences.en: vaccines, or I guess underestimating people's willingness to try this coming coronavirus vaccine.
sentences.zh: 疫苗的怀疑程度，或者说我猜是低估了人们尝试即将推出的冠状病毒疫苗的意愿。

sentences.en: Not since I was a kid have we faced a disease that we're afraid of for which a vaccine exists.
sentences.zh: 自从我小时候以来，我们还从未遇到过一种让我们感到害怕、同时又存在疫苗的疾病。

sentences.en: And when I was a kid, that happened with polio, people took the vaccine, even when bad things happen with that vaccine.
sentences.zh: 在我小时候，小儿麻痹症就是这样，人们接种了疫苗，即使该疫苗曾出现过不良反应。

sentences.en: So you're saying once there is a vaccine for the coronavirus, you expect a similar
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，一旦有了针对冠状病毒的疫苗，你预计会看到类似的

sentences.en: pattern of usage to unfold.
sentences.zh: 使用模式出现。

sentences.en: Assuming people are still afraid of the coronavirus?
sentences.zh: 前提是人们仍然害怕冠状病毒？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What exactly makes you think that a vaccine will be approved in the coming months?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么让你认为疫苗会在未来几个月内获批？

sentences.en: Because I have listened to the CEOs of the major vaccine companies attempt to downplay some of the rapid timetables
sentences.zh: 因为我听过各大疫苗公司的首席执行官试图淡化一些总统提出的迅速时间表

sentences.en: that have been offered by the president and say, look, this will not happen in the next couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 并表示，听着，这不会在接下来的几周内发生。

sentences.en: Be patient.
sentences.zh: 请耐心点。

sentences.en: I don't expect a vaccine by election day, but lots of experts who are a pretty
sentences.zh: 我不指望在选举日前能有疫苗，但许多对这些试验进展有相当

sentences.en: clear idea of what's going on in these trials do expect one or two or three vaccines approved somewhere around end of the year, beginning of next year.
sentences.zh: 清晰了解的专家确实预计，在今年年底或明年年初左右，会有一、二或三款疫苗获批。

sentences.en: And there are reasons for expecting that.
sentences.zh: 有理由期待这一点。

sentences.en: They're reasonable.
sentences.zh: 这是合乎情理的。

sentences.en: By that time, they should have time to both see enough infections in the vaccine trial to make a judgment as to whether or not the vaccine works.
sentences.zh: 到那个时候，他们应该有足够的时间在疫苗试验中观察到足够多的感染病例，从而判断疫苗是否有效。

sentences.en: And they should also have the vaccine have gone into enough people and waited for at least a couple of months to see if any dangerous side effects emerge.
sentences.zh: 而且，疫苗也应该已经接种到足够多的人身上，并等待了至少几个月，以观察是否会出现任何危险的副作用。

sentences.en: And those are the two things you're looking for.
sentences.zh: 这正是你所寻找的两个方面。

sentences.en: Does it work?
sentences.zh: 它有效吗？

sentences.en: Does it cause dangerous side effects?
sentences.zh: 它会引起危险的副作用吗？

sentences.en: And if the answer is yes and no, then you've got a winner.
sentences.zh: 如果答案是有效且没有副作用，那你就算赢了。

sentences.en: And we might have three or four winners by, you know, fairly early next year.
sentences.zh: 你知道，到明年年初较早的时候，我们可能会有三到四个胜利者。

sentences.en: So given that vaccine timeline that you just outlined, when do you believe most Americans would get the vaccine and when something approaching normalcy could be achieved?
sentences.zh: 那么，鉴于你刚刚概述的疫苗时间表，你认为大多数美国人什么时候能打上疫苗，什么时候能恢复接近正常的生活？

sentences.en: If we have several vaccines and if nothing goes wrong with the multiple manufacturing processes that
sentences.zh: 如果我们有几款疫苗，并且我们目前正在建设的

sentences.en: are being built as we speak, I think there may be enough doses for all Americans to get them by
sentences.zh: 多条生产线在生产过程中一切顺利，我认为到2021年春末到盛夏之间的某个时候

sentences.en: sometime late spring to mid-summer of 2021.
sentences.zh: 可能会有足够的所有美国人接种的剂量。

sentences.en: Which is a whole lot faster than the four-year timetable that you and I had discussed many months ago.
sentences.zh: 这比你我几个月前讨论的四年时间表要快得多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We started taking this disease seriously in March.
sentences.zh: 我们从三月份开始严肃对待这种疾病。

sentences.en: So you could argue that it's, you know, might last a year and three months or so.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以说，你知道，它可能会持续一年零三个月左右。

sentences.en: So beyond the vaccine, which seems crucial to your optimism, clearly, what else gives you optimism?
sentences.zh: 因此，除了对你的乐观至关重要的疫苗之外，还有什么能让你感到乐观？

sentences.en: The other intervention that experts have a lot of confidence in is monoclonal antibodies.
sentences.zh: 专家们抱有很大信心的另一种干预手段是单克隆抗体。

sentences.en: And remind us what monoclonal antibodies do to the virus.
sentences.zh: 请提醒我们，单克隆抗体对病毒有什么作用？

sentences.en: Those are sort of a Superman version of convalescent plasma because you take the antibodies from the
sentences.zh: 它们有点像是恢复期血浆的“超人”版本，因为你从康复者的血浆中提取抗体

sentences.en: plasma of survivors and you look for the best ones, the ones that are really good at neutralizing the virus.
sentences.zh: 并寻找最好的那些，也就是真正擅长中和病毒的抗体。

sentences.en: And you clone those.
sentences.zh: 然后你对它们进行克隆。

sentences.en: And then if somebody is already infected and sick, you give them a big dose, hoping that it wipes out all the virus in their bloodstream.
sentences.zh: 接着，如果有人已经感染生病了，你给他们大剂量注射，希望它能清除他们血液中的所有病毒。

sentences.en: And if you want to protect somebody, there's a second way of using it in a sort of ring vaccination form to protect people who are close to someone who's been infected.
sentences.zh: 如果你想保护某人，还有第二种使用方法，类似于环状免疫的形式，用来保护那些与感染者密切接触的人。

sentences.en: So if, you know, I had a family of five and I was infected, you could treat me, but also prophylactically vaccinate everybody in my family, hoping that I didn't pass it on to them.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，如果我有五口之家而我感染了，你可以治疗我，也可以对我家里的每个人进行预防性接种，希望我不会把它传给他们。

sentences.en: And, you know, ring vaccination is how we beat smallpox.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，环状免疫就是我们战胜天花的方法。

sentences.en: Ring vaccination is how we fight Ebola.
sentences.zh: 环状免疫也是我们抗击埃博拉的方法。

sentences.en: When you have cases that occur in tight clusters, you can use small doses of antibodies like a vaccine to vaccinate everybody around every known case.
sentences.zh: 当病例呈紧密集群出现时，你可以像使用疫苗一样使用小剂量的抗体，来为每个已知病例周围的所有人进行接种。

sentences.en: And if you do that right, you can really slow transmission dramatically.
sentences.zh: 如果你做得对，真的可以大幅减缓传播。

sentences.en: So this feels like the next best thing to a vaccine from what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 所以从你的话听起来，这感觉像是仅次于疫苗的最好选择。

sentences.en: So where in the development process is monoclonal antibodies at this point?
sentences.zh: 那么，单克隆抗体目前处于开发的哪个阶段？

sentences.en: Quite close.
sentences.zh: 相当接近了。

sentences.en: They were hoping to have them approved by late August, early September.
sentences.zh: 他们希望在8月下旬、9月初获得批准。

sentences.en: Trials have gone more slowly than they hoped, but they're pretty close to reaching an end and they might function as a bridge to the day when we get vaccines.
sentences.zh: 试验的进展比他们希望的要慢，但他们已经非常接近终点，它们可能会成为通往我们获得疫苗那一天的一座桥梁。

sentences.en: So if you ask me why I'm optimistic, it's because I see these big technological advances coming down the road.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你问我为什么乐观，那是因为我看到了这些即将到来的巨大技术进步。

sentences.en: They are not coming on the president's schedule for reelection, but they are coming nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 它们没有按照总统连任的时间表到来，但它们终究会到来。

sentences.en: I'm pretty confident in that.
sentences.zh: 对此我相当有信心。

sentences.en: And I talked to a lot of experts.
sentences.zh: 我跟很多专家交流过。

sentences.en: So you just mentioned the president, and I think we have to talk about his infection and whether or not that subtracts from your optimism or it amplifies it.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到了总统，我想我们必须谈谈他的感染，以及这究竟是会削弱还是增强你的乐观情绪。

sentences.en: And I'm really curious how you have been thinking about that event as you contemplate the end of this pandemic and your growing optimism.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，当你思考这场大流行的结束以及你日益增长的乐观情绪时，你是如何看待那一事件的？

sentences.en: I think it has the potential to add to my sense of optimism.
sentences.zh: 我认为这有可能增添我的乐观情绪。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Well, one, he had a big scare.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第一，他受到了很大的惊吓。

sentences.en: And for a little while there, he was wearing masks and even advocating wearing masks.
sentences.zh: 在有一段时间里，他戴上了口罩，甚至倡导戴口罩。

sentences.en: Since he tested positive.
sentences.zh: 自从他检测呈阳性以来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's very clear that the virus spread like wildfire in the anti-mask White House.
sentences.zh: 很明显，病毒在反口罩的白宫里如野火般蔓延。

sentences.en: So a lot of his followers may take a look at the situation and say, huh, maybe I should wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 因此，他的许多支持者可能会看看这种情况并想：呃，也许我也应该戴口罩。

sentences.en: If that happens, if a few million more Americans start wearing masks, that can make a big difference this fall and winter because we know that masks decrease transmission.
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，如果有几百万更多的美国人开始戴口罩，今年秋冬可能会带来巨大的改变，因为我们知道口罩可以减少传播。

sentences.en: But I want to understand your optimism, Donald, because yes, the president did say wear a mask
sentences.zh: 但我想理解你的乐观，唐纳德，因为是的，总统在感染病毒后确实说过要戴口罩

sentences.en: once he got the virus, but he also took real and very public risks once he was diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 但他在确诊后也采取了真实且非常公开的冒险行为。

sentences.en: He drove around in an SUV, potentially exposing his Secret Service detail very publicly.
sentences.zh: 他坐着SUV四处兜风，非常公开地让他的特勤局随行人员面临潜在暴露风险。

sentences.en: He returned to the White House quickly and very dramatically removed his mask, which surprised people and sent not exactly a wear a mask message.
sentences.zh: 他很快返回白宫，并且非常戏剧性地摘下了口罩，这让人们感到震惊，传达的信息可绝对不是“戴口罩”。

sentences.en: And then in a video that was directed to his supporters and the public, he very much minimized his experience with the virus and said, don't let it dominate your life.
sentences.zh: 然后在一段针对他的支持者和公众的视频中，他极大地淡化了自己感染病毒的经历，并说“不要让它主宰你的生活”。

sentences.en: Just today, he compared the coronavirus to the flu.
sentences.zh: 就在今天，他还把冠状病毒比作流感。

sentences.en: And so does that potentially undermine whatever value there was in saying wear a mask?
sentences.zh: 所以这是否有可能破坏“戴口罩”这一说法的价值？

sentences.en: Well, look, if you look at what people who are big fans of the president see, they see him
sentences.zh: 听着，如果你看看总统的坚定支持者们看到了什么，他们看到的是

sentences.en: not wearing a mask and then getting really slapped by the virus.
sentences.zh: 他不戴口罩，然后被病毒狠狠地扇了一巴掌。

sentences.en: And the whole White House has been hit hard by the virus.
sentences.zh: 整个白宫都受到了病毒的重创。

sentences.en: And that in and of itself is a lesson.
sentences.zh: 这本身就是一堂生动的课。

sentences.en: Even if he says, don't be afraid of the virus,
sentences.zh: 即使他说“不要害怕病毒”，

sentences.en: he had to go to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他也不得不去医院。

sentences.en: Chris Christie's in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·克里斯蒂也在医院。

sentences.en: Other people around him may have to go to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 他周围其他人可能也得去医院。

sentences.en: We don't know how it's going to turn out for all of those people.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道所有这些人最终会怎么样。

sentences.en: So the hard lesson you take away from that is the virus is not a Democratic hoax.
sentences.zh: 所以你从中吸取的惨痛教训是，病毒不是民主党的骗局。

sentences.en: The virus was a close call for our leader and is infecting other people who followed his lead.
sentences.zh: 病毒对我们的领导人来说是一次千钧一发，并且正在感染其他追随他的人。

sentences.en: And maybe I don't want what happened in the White House to happen in my house.
sentences.zh: 也许我可不希望白宫发生的事在我家发生。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people may take that lesson away.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人可能会从中吸取教训。

sentences.en: You know, generally, I'm optimistic.
sentences.zh: 你知道，总的来说，我很乐观。

sentences.en: Which is new for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说是个新鲜事。

sentences.en: Well, on that note, we should be clear that this optimism still entails
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我们应该清楚，这种乐观仍然意味着

sentences.en: many, many months of living with the virus.
sentences.zh: 还要忍受与病毒共存的很多很多个月。

sentences.en: Next spring is not exactly around the corner.
sentences.zh: 明年春天可并不就在拐角处。

sentences.en: It involves potentially millions more infections.
sentences.zh: 这可能还涉及数百万人的感染。

sentences.en: It involves tens of thousands of deaths, less, more economic hardship.
sentences.zh: 这涉及数万人的死亡，以及更多、更严重的经济困难。

sentences.en: So maybe optimism isn't exactly the right word for it.
sentences.zh: 所以“乐观”可能并不是最准确的词。

sentences.en: I'm not sure what the word would be, but it's not exactly ideal.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该用什么词，但它绝对不算是理想状态。

sentences.en: No, it's not ideal.
sentences.zh: 不，这并不理想。

sentences.en: I mean, but once we knew there was going to be a pandemic, we couldn't really have an expectation that everything was going to go duckily.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一旦我们知道会有大流行，我们就不能真正期望一切都会一帆风顺。

sentences.en: But I hope it's going to be over earlier than I expected.
sentences.zh: 但我希望它能比我预期的更早结束。

sentences.en: And then we can begin the work of economic recovery and
sentences.zh: 然后我们可以开始经济复苏的工作，

sentences.en: people going back to work, people living life the way we used to before.
sentences.zh: 人们重返工作岗位，人们像以前一样生活。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's a relative form of optimism.
sentences.zh: 这是一种相对的乐观。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, Don, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，唐，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you for inviting me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: On Tuesday afternoon, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周二下午，美国

sentences.en: Food and Drug Administration released new, stricter guidelines for companies developing vaccines for the coronavirus, guidelines that were initially blocked by the White House.
sentences.zh: 食品药品监督管理局为开发冠状病毒疫苗的公司发布了新的、更严格的指南，这些指南最初曾遭到白宫的阻止。

sentences.en: The guidelines recommend gathering extra data about a vaccine's safety in the final stage of clinical trials, a step that would take more time, but is expected to
sentences.zh: 该指南建议在临床试验的最后阶段收集关于疫苗安全性的额外数据，这一步骤需要更多时间，但预计会

sentences.en: increase the public's confidence in an eventual vaccine.
sentences.zh: 增强公众对最终疫苗的信心。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, President Trump abruptly ended negotiations with congressional
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普总统突然终止了与国会

sentences.en: Democrats over an economic relief bill, instructing Republicans to instead focus on confirming his nominee for the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 民主党人关于经济救助法案的谈判，转而指示共和党人专注于确认他提名的最高法院大法官人选。

sentences.en: The announcement sent the stock market plunging and means there is no chance that the federal government will deliver assistance to struggling Americans and
sentences.zh: 这一宣布导致股市暴跌，意味着联邦政府在选举前向苦苦挣扎的美国人和

sentences.en: businesses before the election.
sentences.zh: 企业提供援助的机会已经破灭。

sentences.en: And the coronavirus outbreak inside of the White House has spread further.
sentences.zh: 白宫内部的冠状病毒疫情进一步蔓延。

sentences.en: The vice commandant of the Coast Guard, who had attended a White House event a few days ago,
sentences.zh: 几天前曾参加白宫活动的海岸警卫队副司令

sentences.en: has now tested positive, forcing several members of the Joint Chiefs of Staff to quarantine.
sentences.zh: 现在检测呈阳性，导致参谋长联席会议的多名成员被迫隔离。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday night, Stephen Miller, a senior advisor to the president, said that he too had tested positive.
sentences.zh: 周二晚间，总统高级顾问史蒂芬·米勒表示，他也检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称是改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人热血沸腾的争斗之中。

sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我是

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 萨拉·科尼格，我们将为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。
